google_review_notes: No login required. Aspect Ratio Calculator opens on the Resize tab after a 3-card intro (Skip). Type a width or height to see the other side, the reduced ratio and the live preview frame; Convert changes pixels, inches, cm and mm at any DPI; Saved keeps your own presets (3 free, more with Pro), the batch list (Pro) and recent calculations. Pro and Remove Ads are one-time in-app products (Settings > Purchases); Restore purchases is in the same section. All data stays on the device.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test in-app purchases open Settings (gear, top right) > Purchases: Go Pro (pro_lifetime) or Remove ads (remove_ads); Restore purchases is in the same section. No demo account needed.
